mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."BAT_タスク実行情報" ("タスクコード","タスク種別","起動種別","状態","要求内容","依頼者", "予定時刻","開始時刻","終了時刻","メッセージ","登録日時","更新日時") VALUES (#{taskCode}, 'C', 'C', #{status}, NULL::jsonb, #{requestedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{startTime}, NULL, #{message}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE public."BAT_タスク実行情報" SET "状態" = #{status}, "終了時刻" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "メッセージ" = #{message}, "エラー詳細" = #{errorDetail}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "実行ID" = #{executionId}
mapper.select: SELECT "実行ID","タスクコード","状態","予定時刻","開始時刻","終了時刻","メッセージ","依頼者","登録日時","更新日時" FROM public."BAT_タスク実行情報" WHERE "タスクコード" = #{taskCode} AND "状態" IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') ORDER BY "実行ID" DESC LIMIT 1
